integrity: Exact analytic Fourier-spectrum and polyhedral proof; supplemental independently constructed finite full-Laplacian and vertex checks. No claim of independent external validation or established historical priority.
scientific_limitations: All nonnegative independent edge rates and every positive class price are covered for n at least five; the exact global optimal value is proved.
Only the optimizers invariant under the two-layer cyclic graph symmetries are classified; noninvariant global optimizers are not ruled out.
The result applies to continuous-time symmetric combinatorial-Laplacian mixing, not arbitrary stationary distributions or discrete-time SLEM.
The supplementary finite program cannot certify the infinitely quantified theorem or historical originality.
title: Parity-dependent three-price fastest mixing on crossed circular ladders
